title: S4-DRAW-03 — A bucket respects its boundary.
goal: Flood Fill stays inside a closed border, leaves an enclosed gray speck alone at tolerance 0, takes the speck when tolerance allows, fills every exact match when Connected pixels only is off, and a locked layer refuses the fill. The fixture is a replay: a white 16×16 field, a dark square outline from (4,4) to (12,12) and a light gray #d8d8d8 speck at (10,10), about 67.5 from white in RGBA distance; the canvas centre (8,8) is inside the border.
cliOnly: coordinate fill at (4,4) on the imported Ink-layer fixture and native RGBA

steps.why: 175 white cells outside, 48 inside, a 32-cell border and one speck.
Exactly the 48 white cells inside the border turn blue; the speck, border and outside stay.
At tolerance 70 the light gray speck (distance about 67.5) fills too; the border and outside are untouched.
A global fill takes every exact white match, inside and outside, but not the speck or border.
The locked layer refuses the fill.
The refused fill added no Undo step: one Undo reverses the lock.
